title: arthropodium hispidum
intro: Arthropodium hispidum, commonly known as New Zealand flax lily or horse's teeth, is a plant species native to New Zealand. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, where it is used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Arthropodium hispidum include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which help in soothing muscle spasms and alleviating pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, coumarins, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
